ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for Macon-Christian County Summer Agriculture Institute participants (June 16th to the 19th.) AND Lake County Alumni Educational Trip participants (June 16th and 17th). Students may elect to register for 2 or 3 credit hours. Students will complete 2 projects for 2 graduate credits and 3 projects for 3 graduate credits. Students taking this course may repeat it, however, only it will only be accepted one time for the Ag Education M.S. program.
